method: Machine check, not a human player check. Fetched each watch page over plain HTTPS and read the caption track list out of the page's own ytInitialPlayerResponse: name, languageCode, and kind, where kind "asr" means automatic speech recognition. Duration comes from lengthSeconds in the same response. Nobody opened the player, played the video, or inspected Settings > Subtitles/CC, and no caption text was read, so this establishes which tracks are served and nothing about their accuracy.
rule: A video may be embedded only once an English caption track that is not labelled auto-generated has been confirmed. Until then it is offered as a plain link, and the page teaches the material in text.
